description:
About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.

The Opportunity:

At Abby Care, we are building an organization at the intersection of healthcare delivery and technology. Our goal is to redefine and set a new standard for home care across the country - leveraging AI-native platforms that drastically improve how caregivers deliver care, more efficiently and safely, and with better outcomes in their homes. We are excited to hire a Senior Clinical Recruiter to drive our nationwide hiring strategy for the clinicians who shape, scale, and elevate care delivery across Abby Care, including RN Case Managers, Clinical Leads, Directors of Nursing and Regional Leadership.

Partnering closely with executive leadership, you will combine deep subject-matter expertise in identifying, engaging, and closing clinical talent with a passion for building scalable, data-driven processes. You take pride in structuring rigorous end-to-end leadership assessments, leveraging metrics to tell the Talent story, and delivering a white-glove candidate experience that strengthens our brand.

A passion for quality, you demonstrate high craft in all that you deliver, you sweat the details and take care in your follow up and follow through. Naturally action oriented, you don’t hesitate to move forward with the ideas and projects that improve how you work. A people person, you are energized by building trusting relationships with your candidates and your stakeholders. If you are excited by solving complex clinical leadership hiring challenges at a high bar, and even higher goals, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a full-time position based either in San Francisco or remotely in the US, priority will be given to candidates who are located in the Central or Eastern time zone

What You’ll Work On:

  • Strategic Advising: Serve as a trusted talent partner to clinical and executive leadership on search process, leadership calibration, compensation benchmarks, and complex closing strategies for clinical talent nationwide.

  • Search & Execution: Own full-cycle recruiting for critical clinical roles, from RN Case Managers and Clinical Leads to Directors and Senior Leadership by architecting bespoke, multi-channel outbound search strategies across LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, and targeted cold outreach.

  • Process & Assessment Optimization: Continuously refine rigorous clinical evaluation frameworks, managing pipelines, and accelerating time-to-hire without sacrificing quality.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Clinical Operations, hiring managers, and other stakeholders to align on staffing needs, streamline handoffs, and uphold compliance standards as we expand into new markets.

  • Storytelling & White-Glove Candidate Experience: Champion the Abby Care mission with urgency and executive presence, delivering a transparent, high-touch candidate journey and compelling outreach that resonates deeply with seasoned clinical builders and care innovators.

  • Data & Market Intelligence: Track recruiting metrics to diagnose pipeline bottlenecks, recommend process improvements, and keep leadership ahead of healthcare recruiting trends and regional talent dynamics.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Leadership Pipeline Velocity: Accelerate early pipeline velocity and hiring throughput across priority clinical markets, cultivating a consistent bench of vetted, mission-aligned clinicians for high-impact roles.

  • Seamless Calibration: Establish strong alignment and tight interview loop calibration with clinical and executive stakeholders through standardized evaluation frameworks, optimized pass-through rates, and rapid decision turnaround.

  • Operational & Compliance Excellence: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and seamless coordination hires move smoothly from initial outreach to licensed start date.

  • Market Leadership: Serve as a proactive advisor on regional clinical compensation, compliance standards, and healthcare talent trends while compellingly articulating Abby Care’s care delivery model and scaling roadmap.

What You’ll Have:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a deep focus on low-volume, high source clinical and healthcare roles across the U.S. in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

  • Proven track record of sourcing, engaging, and closing senior clinical talent, including RN Case Managers, Clinical Leads, Directors of Nursing and Regional Clinical Directors through high-touch outbound sourcing and relationship building.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare delivery models, clinical leadership personas, state licensure and compliance standards, and compensation benchmarks.

  • Advanced proficiency in Ashby (or a comparable contemporary ATS), AI powered sourcing, and recruiting analytics to drive pipeline hygiene, remove bottlenecks, and influence executive hiring decisions with data.

  • A high-ownership mentality with low ego, comfortable operating autonomously and shifting between strategic talent advising and hands-on search execution in a rapidly scaling Series C environment.

  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and critical thinking skills with the credibility to partner with and influence senior clinical leaders.

Our Values

  1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

  2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

  3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

  4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

  5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

Abby Care considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company.

Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.
